sin.name: launcher-stop-outside-agent-program
sin.description: Code asks the launcher to stop a program itself, so whether a program must stop is decided in one more place, and the recorded process and the processes under it are left running when the launcher does not answer.
sin.rule: End the agent's row, and EndedAgentProgramListener stops the program when another ended it. Code that must stop a program itself calls AgentProgram.
